advisories.note: The three MUST-FIX findings share one root cause and it is the cause the frozen v26 review's own advisory CLAUDE-G21FXV26-A-1 predicted: custody and currency facts are restated across many sites, so a successor sweep that repairs the authoritative site can leave stale copies behind. Here the sweep was scoped to the speaker token — every 'g21-fixture-corpus.v26' became 'g21-fixture-corpus.v27', all fourteen of them, with no misses — while the custody advance D-351 to D-353 was applied to findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody, purpose and d351.role but not to the four inherited roles that carry the same fact. Note that the v31 leftover-join REJECT was the mirror image: an over-broad token sweep rewrote one fact it should have left alone. A sweep keyed on tokens cannot distinguish the two. The structural remedy is the one already on record: keep last-heading custody and current-remasurement currency stated once, in findingDisposition, and let basedOn roles carry only facts that are stable across turns — what the entry is, when it was recorded, and what this speaker does not do to it. That removes the class rather than repairing instances of it. This is drafting guidance for the successor, not an independent rejecting finding; the three MUST-FIX findings above reject on their own terms.

decision: REJECT at 3 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The fixture work this artifact exists to do is sound and was verified on the bytes rather than from the catalog: four platform copies at the dispatched paths at mode 0444, each exactly 00 00 00 01, each hashing to the frozen g21-fixture-corpus.v26 payload digest, that digest occurring exactly five times across every fixture file on disk, the frozen fixtures/g21.v22/ source unmoved, no Windows directory, no tracked file modified. All 31 structured path/sha256 pairs and all 34 recordedInputs digests re-hash equal; HEAD, COORD, file 08, the D-353 last heading, required-now 28 and the DR-G21 OPEN token all measure as dispatched; every quotation from control-protocol-contract.v2, occupancy v4 and G10 occupancy v2 is verbatim, and the four platform tokens are ORDERED-EQUAL to G23. Nineteen of the twenty-two attacks fail to land. What rejects is custody hygiene. The v26 to v27 successor sweep advanced the speaker token at all fourteen inherited sites but carried the D-351 to D-353 custody advance into only some of the places that state it. As a result basedOn.sarifLeftoverJoinV14.role names basedOn.d351.role as the sole last-heading claimant while purpose and findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody name basedOn.d353.role and d351.role itself says 'Not last-heading'; basedOn.d350.role, basedOn.d348.role and basedOn.d293.role each assert that last-heading custody remains D-351 when live COORD's last heading is D-353 and the subject's own pinned HEAD is the D-353 commit; and basedOn.leftoverJoinV28.role still labels leftover-join.v28 of G21 the current G21 leftover remasurement alongside leftoverJoinV32.role labelling leftover-join.v32 of G21 the same thing, when D-353's own text supersedes v28 on adoption and the lineage's convention — visible in the dual-ACCEPTed v23, v24 and v25 — is to demote the superseded join to 'Predecessor.' These are not stylistic preferences: each is a present-tense claim about live state that live bytes and the artifact's own authoritative fields contradict, and each is the kind of statement a later recording would have to quote. The repairs are four localised string edits that touch no byte, digest, quotation, count, or leftover-design state, so a successor making exactly those edits should measure clean on everything checked here.
